subject: Re: URGENT: production errors + request to retain traces for triage
messages:
From: Priya Desai <priya@fintegral.com>
To: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-06-12T08:15:00Z
Subject: URGENT: production errors + request to retain traces for triage

Hi Laura —

We’re seeing a spike of 502s impacting a subset of requests (customer IDs ending with -47). Our SRE has pulled a few traces but we need Redwood to hold the KV/cache shards and request traces for 72 hours while we triage root cause.

Could you please confirm whether you can preserve the following: request payloads, kv-cache keys for the affected tenant, and the model inference trace for correlation-id X-9f3b?

We know your default retention policies would normally delete ephemeral traces within 24 hrs — we’re asking for a short retention exception to avoid losing crucial context while we debug. We’ll only need the window for ~72 hours.

Attached: prod_trace_snapshot.txt (snippet), correlation-id-mapping.csv

Thanks,
Priya Desai
Head of SRE, Fintegral
priya@fintegral.com
Phone: +1 415 555 0123

--
Fintegral is under an active SLA with Redwood. We appreciate a quick turnaround.

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Desai <priya@fintegral.com>
Cc: monica_patel@redwood.ai, rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-06-12T08:30:00Z
Subject: Re: URGENT: production errors + request to retain traces for triage

Hi Priya — thanks for the context and the attachments. I’ve started an internal escalation so we can approve a minimal, auditable exception. Can you confirm two quick items for scope:

- Exact correlation IDs/timestamp window you want preserved (we saw the X-9f3b note but want a short list)
- Which region the tenant is in (so we can ensure data residency constraints)

As an interim measure we’ll snapshot what we can and restrict access to the triage team only. I’ve CC’d Monica (CS) and Rishi (Support lead) — they’ll coordinate the internal approvals.

I’ll update you within 90 minutes.

—Laura
Laura Bennett
Head of Customer Success, Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.ai

Attachment: prod_trace_snapshot.txt (received)

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai, rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai, monica_patel@redwood.ai, markus_klein@redwood.ai
Cc: security_ops@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-06-12T08:45:00Z
Subject: Escalation: short-term retention exception request — Fintegral outage (customer-facing)

Team —

Summary: Fintegral is requesting a 72-hour retention exception for specific inference traces and kv-cache keys to support an active production triage. They supplied example traces and correlation-id X-9f3b (see attached). Region: us-west-2. SLA: Platinum (contracted).

Request from CS/SRE: snapshot and temporarily preserve the listed artifacts for 72 hours, with:
- Access limited to: Fintegral SRE (external), Redwood triage engineers (rishi, markus)
- Storage location: existing US cloud logs bucket (us-west-2), tagged as "ephemeral-exception/fintegral/20270612"
- KMS policy: customer-managed KMS key is in use for production artifacts — confirm we can use existing key and audit access
- Audit: full access logs, who/when, and automatic deletion after window ends

Proposed approval path: Legal sign-off (data-residency & contract check) + Security ops confirmation (KMS, access controls) + Exec OK from CS (Laura). If approved we’ll document in the incident ticket and notify the customer.

Questions for approvers (please reply inline):
1) Legal — any contractual blockers to holding these artifacts 72 hours in the US region?
2) Security — can we restrict access and ensure automatic purge/deletion and KMSevents for the window?
3) CS/Support — confirm the minimal list of artifacts and that 72 hours is sufficient.

I’ve attached the customer-provided snippet for reference.

Thanks,
Laura

Attachment: prod_trace_snapshot.txt

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
To: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai, monica_patel@redwood.ai, markus_klein@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-06-12T10:10:00Z
Subject: Re: Escalation: short-term retention exception request — Fintegral outage (customer-facing)

Laura / team —

We can approve a timeboxed retention exception with the following mandatory controls:

- Scope: persist only the explicitly listed traces / correlation IDs and any direct request/response payloads necessary for the triage. No broad tenant-level snapshoting.
- Duration: 72 hours from the time of snapshot, with an automated deletion job that is verifiable.
- Access: explicit ACL that limits to named Redwood triage engineers + Fintegral SRE emails listed in the original request. No other internal teams.
- Audit & Documentation: create an incident addendum in the contract portal, log the approval decision, and record KMS key usage and access logs.
- Data residency: storing in us-west-2 is acceptable for this tenant under current contract. No cross-region replication.

Conditionally approved: Security ops must confirm the deletion automation and KMS logging; once security confirms, Legal sign-off is final.

—Lauren Bishop
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
lauren_bishop@redwood.ai

Notes: If Fintegral later requests extended retention or wants Redwood to keep artifacts for internal forensics beyond 72 hours, we’ll require a formal addendum and billing for forensic storage time.

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Desai <priya@fintegral.com>
Cc: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai, monica_patel@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-06-12T10:35:00Z
Subject: Re: URGENT: production errors + request to retain traces for triage — APPROVED (72h)

Hi Priya — quick update. Legal has conditionally approved a timeboxed 72-hour exception for the exact artifacts you flagged (we will persist only the listed correlation IDs, request/response payloads, and related KV cache keys). Security is verifying the deletion automation now; we expect confirmation within 30 mins.

What we will do immediately:
- Snapshot the supplied artifacts and copy to an "ephemeral-exception/fintegral/20270612" folder in us-west-2 (no cross-region replication).
- Apply ACLs limited to: Fintegral SRE (sre@fintegral.com), rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai, markus_klein@redwood.ai
- Enable full access logging and KMS event recording; we’ll attach the logs to the incident ticket.
- Schedule an automated purge at 2027-06-15T10:35:00Z (72 hours) and notify you when deletion completes.

Action required from Fintegral: please reply with the final list of correlation IDs and confirm the requester emails for SRE access.

We’ll send a confirmation once security signs off on the deletion automation.

Thanks for flagging this quickly — we’ll stay on the case.

—Laura
Laura Bennett
Head of Customer Success, Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.ai

Attachment: correlation-id-mapping.csv (received)
